title: The invoice number opens the invoice in the same browser tab
refs: SV-8607 (SBC spec v20 2026-08-17 Story 9 S9-R1; S9-R2; S9-R2a; S9-R2b)
preconds: 1. You have expanded an asset and can see at least one S invoice and (under another customer/asset if needed) one P invoice.
steps:
1. Click a service (S) invoice number link and note where it opens.
2. Go back, then click a parts (P) invoice number link and note where it opens.
expected:
1. Each invoice number on a detail row is a clickable link that opens in the SAME browser tab (no new tab).
2. A service invoice opens the associated work order's Finance tab.
3. A parts invoice opens the associated part sale's Part Requests tab.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Sales By Customer report specification version 20 (S9-R1, S9-R2, S9-R2a, S9-R2b), read on 17 August 2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
